turkiye_competitors.name: Bulutegra
turkiye_competitors.reason: Türkiye sellers için SKU/order aşamasında micro-export paperwork, currency ve customs details hazırlıyor; same customer/job substantially overlaps.

turkiye_competitors.name: PR e-İhracat
turkiye_competitors.reason: Türkiye'den cross-border sellers için ETGB/customs, international shipping and export workflow in one platform.

global_competitors.name: Customs Readiness Doctor
global_competitors.reason: Cross-border seller catalogunu shipment öncesi HS code, origin, weight, SKU/category eksikleri için tarayıp prioritized readiness issues/cleanup export sunuyor; proposed launch-gate job ile doğrudan örtüşüyor.

adjacent_competitors.name: x7trade
adjacent_competitors.reason: Customs pre-validation/clearance automation, fakat primary customer logistics/customs operators rather than Turkish SME sellers.

competition_search_terms: Türkiye e-ihracat SKU gümrük readiness yazılımı
cross border seller customs readiness HS origin SKU
results.market_gap: 2026 düzenlemeleri ihtiyacı doğruluyor ancak SKU/customs readiness ve Türkiye e-ihracat operasyonu halihazırda doğrudan ürünleşmiş.
results.mvp: SKU/ülke checklist, HS/origin/weight/document completeness, issue queue, launch gate.
results.working_logic: SKU + destination → required customs fields/docs → completeness checks → issues/owners → ready/not-ready gate.
results.lovable_credit_breakdown: catalog 80; country/rule templates 90; checks 90; issue queue 70; export/QA 80
results.main_risk: Existing seller platforms and Shopify apps already solve core readiness workflow.
results.validation_assumption: Standalone Türkiye localization is insufficient novelty.
results.rejection_reason: Bulutegra/PR e-İhracat and Customs Readiness Doctor substantially overlap the same seller-side pre-shipment customs readiness job.

turkiye_competitors.name: NavlunMatik
turkiye_competitors.reason: Türkiye TIR/nakliye firmaları için mazot fiyatı, yakıt tüketimi, navlun geliri ve net kârı hesaplayarak hızlı teklif kararını destekliyor; same customer/core pricing job substantially overlaps.

turkiye_competitors.name: İskaysoft Lojistik Yazılımı
turkiye_competitors.reason: Freight rate, fuel consumption/cost, tolls and trip net profit workflow for carriers; same customer and margin calculation workflow overlaps.

adjacent_competitors.name: Maersk fuel surcharge mechanism
adjacent_competitors.reason: Confirms operational repricing need but is a carrier pricing policy, not software sold to SMEs.

competition_search_terms: Türkiye navlun yakıt maliyeti kar hesaplama uygulaması
nakliye mazot fiyatı navlun teklif karlılık yazılımı
fuel surcharge margin pricing road carrier software
results.market_gap: Fuel volatility and surcharge repricing are real, but Turkish carrier pricing/fuel/margin tools already cover the central job. Proposed customer-impact queue adds workflow depth but not enough to make the core job novel.
results.mvp: Lane cost baseline, fuel price update, margin delta, surcharge scenario, customer repricing queue.
results.working_logic: Fuel price change → affected lanes/customers → margin recalculation → proposed surcharge/new quote → approval/action queue.
results.lovable_credit_breakdown: lane/customer model 70; calculator 80; scenarios 60; queue 60; reporting/QA 60
results.main_risk: Low-price local calculator/logistics products already satisfy much of the buyer need.
results.validation_assumption: Automated repricing queue alone is not sufficient differentiation.
results.rejection_reason: NavlunMatik and İskaysoft substantially overlap Turkish carrier fuel-cost, freight pricing and trip-margin decision workflow.
